standard_prerequisites.name: Pseudo-coherence of representatives
standard_prerequisites.use: E is m-pseudo-coherent for all m.

core_obligations: (1) => (2): strictly perfect representatives make E m-pseudo-coherent for all m (independent-representative lemma), and a direct summand of a finite free module is flat, so E|_{U_i} has finite tor dimension by the tor-amplitude lemma (proof lines 12617-12627).
(2) => (1): after shrinking, E has tor amplitude in [a,b]; since E is m-pseudo-coherent for all m, the perfect-precise lemma gives perfection (proof lines 12628-12632).
proof_roadmap: Pseudo-coherence and finite tor dimension from strictly perfect representatives.
difficulty_reason: (1) implies (2) through the independent-representative lemma and flatness of summands of finite free modules; the converse applies the precise lemma after localizing the tor amplitude.
